payload.subject: Derived-State Integrity
payload.name: Derived-State Integrity
payload.purpose: Eliminate the class of defects in which SYNTH's own read paths dirty the working tree, block expedition completion, or leave governance state uncommitted - by classifying every artifact once (durable, input, derived, cache, legacy) and enforcing two invariants: reads never write, and derived state never blocks work.

payload.subject: Derived-State Integrity
payload.name: Derived-State Integrity
payload.description: Eliminate the class of defects in which SYNTH's own read paths dirty the working tree, block expedition completion, or leave governance state uncommitted. Verified evidence: auto-commit fails on every lifecycle transition because explicitly listed gitignored paths are refused by git add (D1); git check-ignore hides indexed paths without --no-index (D2); synth status rewrites two tracked .synth/ai files on every read (D5); the completion gate treats .synth/ai churn as source dirt (D6); 26 files are simultaneously tracked and ignored (D4). The fix classifies every artifact once (durable, input, derived, cache, legacy) and enforces two invariants: reads never write, and derived state never blocks work.
